payload.message:
Right now there isn’t an in-game “enter raid” trigger wired up.

- A raid session only starts when `RaidPlayer.TryEnterRaid()` is called (`Adapters/Players/RaidPlayer.cs:27`), and nothing in the mod calls it (the only wrapper is `RaidSystem.TryInteractPortal`, but it’s also never invoked: `Adapters/Systems/RaidSystem.cs:114`).
- The “portal” is just a saved coordinate near spawn (`Main.spawnTileX`, `Main.spawnTileY - 1`) and no tile/interaction is placed or hooked (`Adapters/Systems/RaidSystem.cs:162`), so there’s nothing to click/use.
- Because `ArcDroneNPC` spawn is gated on `RaidPlayer.IsInRaid` (`Adapters/NPCs/ArcDroneNPC.cs:32`), drones will never spawn until you add a way to call `TryEnterRaid()`.
